content.short: Relic Protocol is a trustless oracle for Ethereum historical data.
content.description: Relic Protocol offers a secure, trustless way for smart contracts to access historical on-chain data. By employing cryptographic techniques such as zk-SNARKs, the protocol lets decentralized apps query Ethereum history without depending on third-party authorities. The on-chain state verification is highly optimized to minimize gas costs, helping apps run more efficiently. Developers can quickly build history-powered dapps with the Solidity and TypeScript SDKs provided by Relic Protocol.
content.meta: A trustless oracle enabling contracts to access Ethereum historical data on-chain. Discover Relic Protocol and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
